I finished primary school so I can read what is written on the fertilizer bag, but I still decide based on what worked last season and what my neighbors are doing. I will apply one bag of NPK and one bag of urea to this 0.41 hectare plot, which I reckon is about 80 kg of nitrogen for each hectare, and I will also spread two ox-cart loads of manure because this land is mine and I want to keep the soil good for the long term. I am planting hybrid maize seed that I get through the FISP coupon, intercropped with pigeon pea like most people around here do, and I will not buy chemicals for weeding because my family can do that by hand twice during the season. There is no river or pump for irrigation here; we depend on the rains that come in November. Between my wife, my younger brother, and myself, we will spend about 60 days working this plot from planting through harvest, and I will hire one young man from the village for 5 days at harvest time when the cobs are heavy and the work is too much.
